comparator.name: Psychology (Dutch)
comparator.sourceNotes: The Dutch Psychology track totals sixty EC per year. Work and Organizational Psychology is selected as the first-listed major on the current Dutch programme page; its major courses are taught in English. Three named six-credit major courses precede the six-credit applied course in year three. The thirty-credit open space includes at least twelve credits from other psychology majors or predefined psychology electives. GROW is zero credit.
components: Introduction to Psychology and History of Psychology
Academic Skills B requires passing Academic Skills A. The first-year sequence completes A before B.

Academic Skills C includes information-literacy and plagiarism tests and 20 experimental-subject participation hours. These are part of the first year that must be completed before thesis entry. GROW guidance carries no credit.

This example uses the Work and Organizational Psychology major. Work Psychology, Organizational Psychology and Diversity and Inclusion at Work each carry 6 EC and are taught in English, even within the Dutch track.

Applied Work and Organizational Psychology is the 6 EC third-year major course. It applies the PATHS model to an organisational problem with stakeholder feedback, a group presentation, individual logs and required participation.
Mobility Window: exchange, Psychology minor and electives

The 30 EC choice space can contain a minor or electives, including study abroad. At least 12 EC must come from non-selected psychology majors or predefined psychology electives. An alternative to this rule requires prior Examination Board approval. No particular choice is assumed.
Bachelor’s Thesis: Work and Organizational Psychology

Thesis entry requires all first-year courses and at least 60 EC from later years. The February group is advised to have 138 EC. A quantitative thesis is illustrated; qualitative or systematic-review versions require their corresponding 3 EC elective before submission.

routeSelection.basis: The generic Dutch target names no major. The current Dutch programme page lists Work and Organizational Psychology first among nine equally formal majors. The original claim that Clinical Psychology was first belongs to the English page and is corrected. The route is selected independently of UCR construction.

courses: New Issues in Contemporary Social Theory

core: Human thought, emotion, behaviour, personality, development and social influence
Clinical mental health, psychopathology, health, stress, assessment and treatment
Brain, cognition, biological psychology and neuropsychology
Psychological research, statistics, test theory, data science and professional ethics
adjacent: Clinical, medical, health and lifespan psychology
Social, forensic, economic, work and organisational applications of psychology
Quantitative, qualitative and evidence-based psychological research
questions: How do biological, cognitive, social and developmental processes shape behaviour?
How are psychological problems, stress and illness assessed, explained and treated?
How can psychological claims and interventions be tested with sound evidence and data?

alternatives.label: Broad psychology, behaviour & research
alternatives.labelReason: Study behaviour and mental processes through social, developmental, clinical and cognitive psychology, research, philosophy and social context. Leadership, organisational psychology and inclusive workplace inquiry give additional attention to motivation, group processes and psychological safety.
alternatives.concept: Study behaviour and mental processes through social, developmental, clinical and cognitive psychology, research, philosophy and social context. Leadership, organisational psychology and inclusive workplace inquiry give additional attention to motivation, group processes and psychological safety.
progression: Verified all offerings and formal prerequisites. Introductory leadership precedes organisational psychology; research methods precedes advanced statistics and the inclusive-leadership survey project. Psycholinguistics follows its formal brain gateway in its sole planned term.

alternatives.label: Clinical, health & lifespan psychology
alternatives.labelReason: Study mental health and development across the lifespan through psychopathology, introductory assessment and psychotherapy, health psychology, neuroscience, emotion and ethics. Epidemiology and selected biological treatment foundations complement this psychological core.
alternatives.concept: Study mental health and development across the lifespan through psychopathology, introductory assessment and psychotherapy, health psychology, neuroscience, emotion and ethics. Epidemiology and selected biological treatment foundations complement this psychological core.
progression: Verified current offerings and every earlier formal prerequisite. Research methods precedes behavioural statistics, psychopathology precedes assessment, and data science precedes machine learning and image processing. Psycholinguistics follows the brain gateway in its only planned 2027h1 offering; no additional prerequisite is invented.
alternatives.distinctness: This option gives more weight to epidemiology, physiology, pharmacology, ethics and emotion theory and less to leadership and social theory. The biological courses support particular health and treatment questions rather than substituting for psychological study.

alternatives.label: Brain, cognition & behavioural science
alternatives.labelReason: Study brain, cognition and behaviour through neuroscience, perception, language and higher cognitive functions. Combine psychological research and clinical foundations with data analysis, machine learning, image processing and critical inquiry into AI and human agency.
alternatives.concept: Study brain, cognition and behaviour through neuroscience, perception, language and higher cognitive functions. Combine psychological research and clinical foundations with data analysis, machine learning, image processing and critical inquiry into AI and human agency.
progression: Verified current offerings and every earlier formal prerequisite. Research methods precedes behavioural statistics, psychopathology precedes assessment, and data science precedes machine learning and image processing. Psycholinguistics follows the brain gateway in its only planned 2027h1 offering; no additional prerequisite is invented.
alternatives.distinctness: This option develops a computational and cognitive emphasis through data science, machine learning, image processing, AI ethics and agency. It retains psychological and clinical foundations. Molecular pathology and generic laboratory training are removed rather than treated as cognitive science.

blocks: Both develop research design, measurement, sampling and evaluation of empirical evidence. UCR also includes statistics and a research project.

Both examine individual differences, motivation and collaboration as influences on effective functioning at work. UCR uses leadership theory and reflective development; Tilburg also covers personnel selection, training and job design.

Both examine inclusion, social differences, belonging and psychological safety in organisational settings. UCR focuses on leadership and emotional processes under pressure and uses an original survey project.
Both examine psychological processes in organisations, including attitudes, motivation, teams, leadership and change, and connect research evidence with organisational problems.
Both examine ethical reasoning and competing responsibilities. Tilburg applies these to professional psychological practice; UCR develops broader moral theory.
Both examine consciousness, mind and accounts of mental states through philosophical argument.
Both introduce sociological theories, institutions, social relationships and inequality.
Both examine biological and neural mechanisms underlying psychological processes.
Both examine perception and action as psychological functions. UCR emphasises neural mechanisms and neuropsychological explanations.
Both relate brain structure, neural processes and psychological functions to behaviour.
Both study social influence, group processes, attitudes and interpersonal behaviour through psychological research.
Both develop regression modelling, statistical assumptions and interpretation of behavioural evidence. UCR also addresses experimental design and other methods.
Both examine classification, explanations and treatment of mental disorders.

Both address psychological testing, reliability, validity and interpretation. Tilburg develops psychometric item analysis and test models; UCR approaches measurement through broader introductory clinical assessment and psychotherapy.
Both examine physical, cognitive, emotional and social development across life stages and theoretical explanations of change.
No additional selected course directly reproduces this dedicated psychology or professional-skills component.
Philosophical agency is not personality-trait psychology. Developmental and organisational courses contain relevant topics but are placed with their strongest overall counterparts.
Selected research and statistics courses include introductory statistics, but their strongest placements are research methodology and correlational methods. They are not counted twice.

The organisational-psychology course is already placed with the theoretical module. Other applied projects work in different fields and are not treated as the dedicated PATHS organisational-intervention course.
Open space is not instantiated as a particular course, minor or placement.
Selected evidence-synthesis and machine-learning courses use different methods from the external advanced psychological statistics sequence.

No compulsory individual thesis is scheduled at UCR. Optional independent research is shown separately outside scheduled credits.

notes.text: Tilburg combines broad psychology with a named major, professional skills, advanced methods and a required thesis. This example uses Work and Organizational Psychology, taught in English within the Dutch degree. UCR combines psychological and cognitive study with organisational, social, health or data perspectives; it does not reproduce the full specialist or professional sequence.

selection.assessment: The broad psychology option is the strongest general response and now includes a stronger organisational strand. Clinical/health development and cognitive/data inquiry remain separately evidenced psychological priorities. Each pair passes the thirty-credit floor. Additional forensic, economic and more narrowly occupational curricula remain coherent possibilities beyond the three-option maximum; the comparator’s illustrative major does not redefine the generic target.

audience.programmeDescription: Tilburg’s Dutch Psychology track studies mind and behaviour through broad psychological foundations, research and professional skills. Students then complete a major and a thesis. This example uses Work and Organizational Psychology, whose major courses are taught in English.
audience.comparisonExplanation: UCR offers broad psychology with organisational and leadership study, and related priorities in clinical health and lifespan development or brain, cognition and data methods. Tilburg provides a dedicated psychology major, professional training and thesis. Academic overlap does not establish clinical registration or postgraduate admission.
